description: ADD-ON to anime-kick-card-bonus-off.json: also close the MIXED +6 arm. APPLY ON TOP of that spec, not instead of it - this file contains only the one extra site, so the two never touch the same byte and either can be reverted alone. WHAT CHANGES: 0x143ed780d 'lea ebx,[r14+6]' -> 'lea ebx,[r14+0]', one inline immediate, instruction length unchanged. WHY IT IS SEPARATE: that arm is reached by EITHER the player owning card 0x34 OR a purely situational flag at [rsp+0x21] (set from the 0x143ee25c0 predicate together with a kick action id in 8..0xa, no player data involved). One immediate cannot tell the two apart, so zeroing it removes a genuine situational reward for a well-set-up kick as well as the card bonus. That is the trade this file exists to make explicit. WHO IT AFFECTS: everyone - both teams, human-controlled and CPU. DEMONSTRATED (a-emulated, this session, same harness as the parent spec: real 0x143ed7440 and 0x143ed71d0 on the PRISTINE image, SKILL_HAS forced 0/1, 264 situations): with the parent spec alone the all-cards-minus-no-cards delta was already {+0 in all 264} in this sweep, because the +6 arm never executed in it - so this file's benefit is NOT demonstrated here, it is inferred from the disassembly (b-disassembly: the arm is guarded by 'cmp dl,r9b / jae 0x143ed780d' where dl is the card-0x34 counter). An earlier pass, on a world where the arm did fire, measured 24 of 84 sampled situations keeping a +6 card bonus under the parent spec and 0 of 84 under this one. TAKE THIS SPEC IF you are also running anime-unlock-all.json, because forcing the card test true makes the card half of this arm permanently true and the parent spec would then leave a standing +6 on every kick of that type. If you are granting cards per player in DATA instead, and you are happy for a genuine card holder to keep a +6 on well-set-up kicks, you can skip this file. SIDE EFFECTS: removes a situational +6 that has nothing to do with cards; the 22 uncovered card tests inside the kick-miss builder 0x14401a900 and its factor functions are still not addressed by any pack. WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN ONE MATCH: this is the subtlest of the set - compare set-up kicks of the affected type (the well-planted, unhurried strike rather than the scrambled one) before and after; they should lose a little of their extra precision. If you cannot tell the difference, that is a legitimate reason to leave this file off and keep the situational reward. Bytes verified identical in the PRISTINE backup and the installed image; no relative branch in any executable section lands inside 0x143ed780e..0x143ed7810. REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/anime-kick-card-bonus-off-plus6.json

patches.name: +6 -> +0  (card 0x34 OR the [rsp+0x21] situational flag) lea ebx,[r14+6] -> lea ebx,[r14+0]
